site.title: Devi — a bot for your Discord server
site.description: Devi is a Discord bot for moderation, auto responses, music, giveaways, temporary voice channels and AI answers. {count} commands, in English and Russian.

hero.title: A server stays alive while someone keeps holding it together
hero.subtitle: Devi takes that job over: it keeps track of rule breakers, answers the questions people ask every day, plays music, runs giveaways and hands every group its own voice channel.
hero.note: Free to use. Permissions are asked for piece by piece, so you grant only what you need.
hero.demo_reply_prize: Prize: one month of Discord Nitro

features.title: What Devi does
features.subtitle: Thirteen groups of commands that cover most of what people usually install three separate bots for.

moderation.title: Moderation and logs
moderation.text: Warnings with a full history and an "old case" flag, message clean-up, slow mode, roles that expire on their own, and one channel where everything gets written down.

ai.title: AI on your own key
ai.text: The bot replies in a text channel or reads the answer out in voice chat. You set the Gemini key yourself with /ai key, and the conversation history can be wiped at any time.

music.title: Music and speech
music.text: Play from YouTube by link or title, queue tracks, repeat them, and drive it all from a button panel instead of a dozen commands. /tts makes the bot read text aloud.

tempvoice.title: Temporary voice channels
tempvoice.text: Someone joins the lobby channel and Devi creates a room for them. The owner sets the name, user limit, bitrate, region and who is allowed in.

engagement.title: Giveaways and birthdays
engagement.text: Giveaways you can end early or reroll. Members save their own birthday and the greeting goes to the channel you picked.

control.title: Permissions and language
control.text: Grant command access interactively: pick a role or a member and toggle what they can run. The bot's language is set per server.

commands.title: Every command
commands.subtitle: Type part of a name or pick a group.
commands.empty_text: Try another word, or go back to "All".

cmd.mention_user: Mentions a user a given number of times
cmd.mention_role: Mentions a role a given number of times
cmd.trigger: Adds, edits or removes an auto response
cmd.triggers: Lists every trigger on the server
cmd.ball: A magic ball that answers your question
cmd.qr: Turns a link into a QR code
cmd.preview: Fetches the preview of a YouTube video
cmd.send_message: Sends a message to a channel as the bot
cmd.send_dm: Sends a direct message as the bot
cmd.send_sticky: Posts a sticky message in a channel
cmd.send_allow: Allows or blocks non-system direct messages
cmd.join: Connects the bot to a voice channel
cmd.leave: Disconnects the bot from a voice channel
cmd.ai_ask_text: Asks the bot a question and replies in the text channel
cmd.ai_ask_voice: Asks the bot a question and speaks the answer in voice
cmd.ai_key: Sets the Gemini API key the AI features need
cmd.clear: Deletes a given number of messages in a channel
cmd.set_log_channel: Sets the channel used for logs
cmd.language: Sets the bot's language for this server
cmd.command_id: Returns the ID of a Devi command
cmd.temp_role: Gives a member a role for a limited time
cmd.slowmode: Sets slow mode for a channel
cmd.warn_obsolete: Marks a warning as an old case
cmd.giveaway_end: Ends a giveaway early and picks the winners
cmd.giveaway_reroll: Picks new winners for a finished giveaway
cmd.music_interface: Opens the player panel with buttons
cmd.music_play: Plays audio from YouTube by link or title
cmd.music_stop: Stops playback and clears the queue
cmd.birthday_channel: Sets the channel for birthday greetings
cmd.voice_setup: Sets up the lobby channel for temporary voice rooms
cmd.voice_interface: Opens the panel for your temporary room
cmd.voice_allow: Lets a user join your room
cmd.voice_ban: Stops a user from joining your room
cmd.voice_kick: Removes a user from your room
cmd.voice_limit: Sets the user limit of your room
cmd.voice_bitrate: Sets the bitrate of your room
cmd.voice_region: Sets the voice region of your room
cmd.permissions_manage: Manages command access: pick a target and toggle permissions
cmd.permissions_list: Shows every permission assigned on the server

cta.title: Add Devi and set it up in a couple of minutes
cta.text: Start with /language and /set_log_channel — the bot walks you through the rest. If something breaks, drop into the support server.

footer.tagline: A bot for Discord servers that have better things to do than moderate.
footer.note: Devi is not affiliated with Discord Inc.
